title: Moonlight, Movimiento & Trenzas <3
long_description:
Hair braiding circle & yoga flow :)

About this Event

Warm invites to our first Moonlight, Movement & Trenzas. 
Hair & braiding have played an important role across different cultures and moments in time: protection, abundance, connection, and ritual. Take the time to slow down and connect with yourself and the sacredess of your hair though braiding. Stay after to move together through a yoga flow designed to ground you through poses & breath work.
Nos vemos pronto 🫂
• bring your own yoga mat :)
